headline: Housing Crisis Brings Tens of Thousands Onto Streets, Also in Portugal. Prices Have Exploded, Rents Have Risen 68%
summary: Tens of thousands of people protested across more than 30 Portuguese cities on Saturday, in the largest demonstrations yet against the housing crisis. Prices have surged and rents have risen 68 percent.
why: Housing costs affect household spending, construction activity and the policy debate on rents, taxes and mortgages in the Portuguese economy.
